note: This file is a pure configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines dataset settings for SimCLR self-supervised learning on ImageNet using MMPreTrain-style config dicts.
summarize_config: summarize the SimCLR ImageNet dataset configuration including data preprocessor, view pipeline augmentations, and train dataloader settings
review_view_pipeline: review the view_pipeline augmentation transforms including RandomResizedCrop, RandomFlip, ColorJitter, RandomGrayscale, and GaussianBlur
review_train_pipeline: review the train_pipeline that loads images, creates 2 views via MultiView, and packs inputs
review_train_dataloader: review the train_dataloader configuration with batch_size 32, 4 workers, and DefaultSampler shuffle
review_data_preprocessor: review the SelfSupDataPreprocessor settings with ImageNet mean and std normalization values
